implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Registers the task router, which exposes the /tasks POST endpoint for creating new tasks.
implementation.name: app.include_router(task_router)
implementation.pseudo_code:
Initialize FastAPI app
Include the task_router, which provides the /tasks endpoint

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Defines the POST /tasks endpoint. Receives validated TaskCreate data, calls the service layer, and handles exceptions.
implementation.name: create_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
When a POST request is made to /tasks with TaskCreate data:
    Try to create a task using the service layer
    If successful, return the created task
    If an error occurs, raise HTTP 400 with error details

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Service layer method called by the controller. Logs the operation and delegates to the repository to persist the task.
implementation.name: TaskService.create_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
Log the creation attempt with user_name
Call repository.add_task with the provided TaskCreate data
Return the result

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Handles the actual persistence of the new task. Assigns an ID, saves to JSON, and returns the created Task.
implementation.name: TaskRepository.add_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
Create a Task object with a new ID and the provided data
Append the Task to the in-memory list
Increment the ID counter
Save all tasks to the JSON file
Log the creation
Return the created Task

missing_implementations: No UI component for adding tasks is present in the repository.
No explicit validation for required fields beyond what is defined in the TaskCreate model.
